text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's drizzling today. I decide to stop by
the
training track, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's a new record for my top speed
duration.
Next up...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there! You're still training in this
weather?
It looks like it's about to pour.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And? What's it got to do with you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Guarded as ever. I was just worried it'd
impact
your condition, what with a race
on the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Like I'd buy that excuse. You're only
here out
of "scientific curiosity".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna pack up 'cause of some
rain, go right
ahead. You're in the way.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Strict as ever too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's slippery. I need to recheck my

footwork.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I should probably start my last spurt on
the early
side...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I agree! Ultimately, it'll come down
to what
you reach first: the goal, or your
stamina's limit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That said, perhaps you'd sooner break
your limits than give into them. Just
think what revelations
you could find in
the heat of a race!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...The projected numbers are all within
the
expected range. It's just a matter of
letting my
body catch up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see you're still putting all your
faith in numbers. I would warn you,
though—your body won't always
perform
like you expect it to.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But if you absolutely want to improve
fast, I've
got just the thing. Take this
special Tachyon
brand—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
ARGH! Stop backseating already!
Weren't you
gonna go home?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And leave my dear friend in the rain? I
couldn't possibly! Surely, a
logically-inclined individual
like you has
a method to this madness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The weather forecast indicates clear
skies for the
next few days. Would it not
be more rational to
wait?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Sorry, but I don't care what
numbers
they've got on the news. I only
trust my own data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? And what's that data say? That it'll
rain on
the big day? That you should
tough it out in the
mud for good luck?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Butt out. My logic is absolute. That's
why I'm
eliminating the possibility of any
deviation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well now! You're convinced of your
conclusion
without testing! What
passion... or should I say
fanaticism?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Though I suppose a scientist has to take
a few
hypotheses for granted, or you'd
never get
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not an idealist like you.
I'm not doing this out
of any love for science. All I care
about is
winning.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Is realism not an ideal itself?
How many
variables can one cherry-pick
before they
become idealistic?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Look, just LEAVE already! Or do you want me to leak all your reports?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, how scary! It would be a problem if
someone
saw my top-secret research.
Guess it's time for me
to take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and one last thing... Don't worry
about recording your physical data. I'd
be more than
happy to measure
everything for you. Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, I don't remember asking. I know
myself
better than anyone, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's out of the way, back to
testing. I
have to calculate how much
force to put in my
steps, and then...
